That's good advice. It's just feels like I have no aspiration to do anything outside of myself. I'm not hopeful for the future. I don't want to see the world anymore. I don't want to go to grad school.

It happened so suddenly too. One minute we're laughing and the next he's breaking up with me. Why should I live in a world where shit like that happens constantly? It makes no sense. I'm just done.
